Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

Heard Sri Dhananjay Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Tanay Kumar,
learned AGA for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 68 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 406, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Lohta, District- Varanasi,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and co-accused Dharmendra Kumar on 6.3.2022 and according to the FIR, on the inducement of co-accused Dharmendra Kumar Rs. 1 lac was transferred in the account of the applicant for the purpose of installation of solar submersible pump but neither submersible pump was installed nor money of the informant was returned.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and principle accused in the present matter is co-accused Dharmendra Kumar who was the chairman of the Lord Buddha Educational and Welfare Trust and applicant is one of the employee of the trust and as per the allegation, on the inducement made by co-accused Dharmendra Kumar money of 1 lac was transferred in the account of the applicant.

sentences.text: He further submitted that although, applicant is having criminal history of three other cases but his criminal history has been explained in paragraph no. 20 of the affidavit and applicant is in jail, in the present matter, since March, 2022 i.e. for almost one year.

Per contra, learned AGA although, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that co-accused Dharmendra Kumar has already been released on bail and on the inducement of Dharmendra Kumar who was chairman of the firm, money was transferred in the account of the applicant and in the present matter, applicant is in jail since March, 2022 i.e. for almost a year.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

As per the allegation, on the inducement made by co-accused Dharmendra Kumar Rs. 1 lac was transferred in the account of applicant and admittedly Dharmendra Kumar was the chairman of the firm Lord Buddha Educational and Welfare Trust and Dharmendra Kumar has already been released on bail and applicant, in the present matter, is in jail since March, 2022 although, he is having criminal history of three other cases but his criminal history has been explained in paragraph no. 20 of the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.

entities.text: Lord Buddha Educational and Welfare Trust
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Therefore, from the discussion made above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Ajit Kumar Prasad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
